title: Travel wallet operating procedures (scratchpad)
content:
Notes to self - working draft (do not share externally)

Purpose:
- Capture the day-to-day operating steps for the petty travel wallet used at on-site events, roadshows, and last-mile vendor payments. This is an evolving scratchpad: keep it concise and pragmatic.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
1) Two physical wallets: Primary (event lead) + Backup (concierge). Keep signed custody sheet.
2) Single corporate petty card for micro-payments (<= $500) — card in safe at venue; swipe log + scanned receipts on SameDay.
3) Local vendor cash float (USD/EUR/local) for taxis, tips, incidental vendor purchases. Reconcile within 72 hours.

Pre-event prep checklist:
- Confirm wallet custodian (name + phone) and back-up. Put both in #events-ops Slack pinned message.
- Load petty card: ensure $1,000 pre-authorized OR confirm virtual card is live.
- Request local currency float from finance (code EXP-TRV-OP) 5 business days before event.
- Shell envelope labels: "Hotel tips", "Onsite vendors", "Taxis & rides", "Misc (receipts)".
- Download merchant quickpay apps and credentials for common partners (Catering Co, Onsite AV, Booth Movers).

Wallet handling rules (must-follow):
- Two-person rule for cash > $250: custodian and witness sign custody sheet (photo to slack #events-ops).
- Never leave wallet unattended in a vehicle. If wallet left in hotel safe, log time in sheet.
- All receipts collected. If vendor provides no receipt, take a photo and note vendor name, approximate amount, and reason.
- Single-day reconciliation: card receipts + cash tally + photo log -> upload to /TALON/expenses/<event-code> (Confluence runbook link above).

Expense coding (quick reference):
- Meals (client-facing): TRV-MEAL-CLIENT
- Meals (internal): TRV-MEAL-INTERNAL
- Taxi / Rideshare: TRV-TRANS
- Vendor services (AV, furniture): TRV-VENDOR
- Petty cash float top-up: TRV-FLOAT
- Lost/replace card fees: TRV-ADMIN
(Confirm codes with finance before month-end; link to finance sheet in linked_artifacts)

Vendor contacts (frequent partners - local copies):
- Bay City Catering — primary: Maria Chen, +1 415-555-0199, maria@baycitycater.com, ACH net30 (note: ask for itemized breakdown)
- QuickLift Movers — ops: Sameer Patel, +1 415-555-0202, quicklift.co/pay (accepts virtual card + invoice)
- Onsite AV — tech lead: Jordan Sim, +1 415-555-0303, invoice to ops@redwood.com; FASTPAY link: https://pay.quickav.com/redwood
- City Taxi (backup): dispatch +1 415-555-0444 (cash accepted), rides should be logged with driver name & plate.

Receipt handling and scanning: 
- Use the company receipts app (SameDay) to scan within 24 hours. Tag with event-code and expense-code. If app fails, forward photo to expense@redwood.com with subject "[EVENT-CODE] Receipt - <vendor> - <amt>".
- For cash disbursements without official receipt, require a short note on custody sheet with witness initial.

Reimbursement flow (summary):
1) Custodian compiles receipts + digital scans (72 hours).
2) Submit expense report in Concur under project/event code. Attach custody sheet photo and list of cash disbursements.
3) Finance does spot audit within 10 business days. Expect reimburse within next payroll cycle.

Edge cases / gotchas (learned from prior roadshows):
- Some venue vendors require a 50% deposit by wire; get approval from finance (OPS-412) before wiring.
- Hotel incidental holds: virtual card may be blocked for authorization amounts > $200. Coordinate with hotel finance desk to pre-authorize lower cap.
- Foreign currency: use company preferred card for FX to avoid cash shortages; keep a small cash buffer for markets with low card acceptance.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether we can add third custodian for high-risk markets (TBD with security).
- Ask legal about signature waivers for vendor receipts older than 6 months.
- Add a quick laminate cheat-sheet with key vendor phone numbers to the wallet (action: Mateo).

Short timeline for next update:
- Feb 25: finalize petty card vendor whitelist and post in Confluence.
- Mar 05: pilot laminated cheat-sheet at SF roadshow.

Relevant links and refs (quick):
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/EVENTS/Travel+Wallet+Runbook
- Jira ticket for float automation: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-412
- Slack channel: #events-ops (pin this doc)

If anything critical is missing, add notes below. Keep this doc intentionally light — operational details should migrate to Confluence once stable.
